support.label: support
support.label_definition: every supporting-fact title in the top-k
notes: transfer probes: trained on SufficiencyBench train states (benchmark labels), label-independent
'plain ctx' rows: same transfer probes on the same passages rendered in benchmark format (no titles, single-space join, whitespace collapsed)
retrained probes / qpp_logreg are trained on the retrieved train split with THIS label; their train scores are 5-fold out-of-fold (threshold selection only)
gating threshold: max-coverage threshold with train precision >= 0.90 on 'sufficient'
pk = gold answer in the first sentence of the closed-book generation and no abstention phrase in that sentence; pk_benchmark_rule = original rule over the whole generation
em/f1 = SQuAD EM/F1 of the first sentence of the 24-token greedy answer; acc_contains = normalised gold in first line and no abstention
